fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the change set fixing tests that wrote fake usage-limit hits into the machine's real root. The planner found the leak: testCtx leaves Ctx.Wd empty and rootcfg.Find("") resolves the process cwd, a package dir under ~/code. It linked the change set to m29-still-healthy and raised one question with two parts: where an empty Wd stops resolving a root, and how a test run fails on writes outside its temp dir. The arbiter decided (empty-wd-finds-no-root): rootcfg.Find("") reports no root, and TestMain in internal/api and cmd/rhiza snapshots any enclosing root's .rhiza-root/ state dir and fails the run on files that appeared or changed. No owner words; nothing left open.
fields.title: Fix tests write fake: autonomous plan interview
